$comment: Install for a checkout: cd /path/to/llvm-project/llvm && test ! -e CMakeUserPresets.json && test ! -L CMakeUserPresets.json && ln -s "$HOME/.config/llvm/CMakeUserPresets.json" CMakeUserPresets.json. Configure with: cmake --preset research. Build the selected tools with: cmake --build --preset research-tools.

configurePresets.name: research
configurePresets.$comment: Configure the LLVM source tree with Ninja for source research, diagnostic output, and small backend experiments.

CMAKE_BUILD_TYPE.$comment: Keep debug information while avoiding the size and runtime cost of a fully unoptimized Debug build.

CMAKE_C_COMPILER.$comment: Use the Clang C compiler found in the current PATH as the host compiler.

CMAKE_CXX_COMPILER.$comment: Use the matching Clang C++ compiler found in the current PATH.

LLVM_ENABLE_PROJECTS.$comment: Enable Clang and include lld source files in the compilation database without building lld by default.

LLVM_TARGETS_TO_BUILD.$comment: Build only the host, AMDGPU, and PTX backends needed for the current research scope.

LLVM_ENABLE_ASSERTIONS.$comment: Keep assertions and LLVM_DEBUG output enabled in the RelWithDebInfo build.

LLVM_OPTIMIZED_TABLEGEN.$comment: Avoid a redundant unconstrained native TableGen sub-build in this RelWithDebInfo configuration.

LLVM_PARALLEL_TABLEGEN_JOBS.$comment: Run one memory-intensive TableGen process at a time to prevent WSL OOM.

LLVM_CCACHE_BUILD.$comment: Reuse compilation results through the installed ccache.

LLVM_USE_LINKER.$comment: Use mold to reduce LLVM link time and peak linker memory usage.

LLVM_USE_SPLIT_DWARF.$comment: Store DWARF in separate files to reduce pressure during large links.

LLVM_USE_RELATIVE_PATHS_IN_DEBUG_INFO.$comment: Use relative debug paths to improve ccache reuse and build-tree portability.

LLVM_APPEND_VC_REV.$comment: Avoid relinking tools merely because the checked-out Git revision changed.

LLVM_INCLUDE_EXAMPLES.$comment: Do not generate build targets for LLVM examples.

LLVM_INCLUDE_BENCHMARKS.$comment: Do not generate build targets for LLVM benchmarks.

LLVM_PARALLEL_COMPILE_JOBS.$comment: Limit concurrent compilations for the current WSL environment with about 4 GiB of RAM.

LLVM_PARALLEL_LINK_JOBS.$comment: Run only one link job at a time to reduce the risk of swapping or OOM.

buildPresets.name: research-tools
buildPresets.$comment: Build only the tools needed for source and backend research; do not build the all target or the lld executable.
